summary: MVP validation for Refúgio da Beleza. Backend: 22/22 pytest passed (1 skipped for business-hours edge). Frontend: end-to-end flow works — register with LGPD toggle, home greeting + 'PROMOÇÃO DA SEMANA', catalog chips + service select + CTA, booking screen (Sem preferência, 14 date pills, 20 time slots), profile edit + toast, sign-out returns to login.

ui_bugs.issue: Time pills show all 20 slots including past times for TODAY. Selecting an already-past time (e.g. 09:00 when local time is later) fires POST /api/appointments and receives 400 'Não é possível agendar no passado'; no visible toast/alert to the user — the UI stays on the booking screen silently.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated', 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated', 'useNativeDriver is not supported' (web fallback).

action_items: In booking.tsx: filter out or visually disable time slots that are earlier than now for today's date (guard both UI and pre-flight before POST /appointments).
Show a user-visible error toast/alert when POST /appointments returns 400/409 so users know why booking didn't complete.

(Doc mismatch only) The problem statement referenced testIDs 'login-goto-register', 'tab-catalog', 'chip-Cabelo', 'catalog-book-cta', 'booking-confirm', 'confirmation-home', 'profile-save-button', 'profile-signout'. Actual testIDs in code are 'go-to-register', 'category-chip-<cat>', 'catalog-book-cta', 'booking-confirm', 'confirmation-home', 'profile-save-button', 'profile-signout', 'register-submit-button', 'login-submit-button'. All flows tested using actual testIDs — no code change needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py availability endpoint returns all 20 slots regardless of current time; consider filtering past times for today so /appointments 400 can't happen through the UI.
server.py uses fixed timezone=UTC in appt_dt parsing; user requested US-3 timezone bug is out of scope per instructions (noted, not tested).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; 1 medium UX gap on past-time booking)

seed_data_creation: Each test run registers a fresh unique user (e2e_<hex>@t.com / senha123) and creates a scheduled appointment which is then cancelled during the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend on https://beauty-booking-467.preview.emergentagent.com is fully functional. Run `pytest backend/tests/test_refugio_api.py -v` for regression. For frontend, use the ACTUAL testIDs listed in action_items[2], NOT the ones from the request. Photo upload not tested (per note). Timezone bug intentionally not tested.
rca_of_issue: Silent booking failure: booking.tsx renders time pills from /api/availability (20 slots) without filtering by current time. When user picks a past slot on today's date, backend correctly returns 400 but the frontend swallows the error, leaving the user on the booking screen with no feedback. Fix: on same-day date, filter out slots where <HH:MM> <= current local HH:MM; also surface API error via existing toast utility.
